title: 234 回文链表
code:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
class Solution:
    def isPalindrome(self, head: Optional[ListNode]) -> bool:
        alist = []
        while head:
            alist.append(head.val)
            head = head.next
        return list(reversed(alist)) == alist
